metadata.title: TensorRT AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from TensorRT Governance Benchmark

components.title: TensorRT
components.description: AI/ML component for TensorRT with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure post-optimization accuracy is benchmarked against the pre-TensorRT baseline

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate each TensorRT engine against the original framework or FP32 baseline before release so optimization-induced accuracy loss is detected.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, top-1/top-5 accuracy

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run the approved validation set through the source model and the TensorRT engine; compute task metrics and compare candidate engine results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure TensorRT engine quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal FP32 baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT is an inference optimization SDK, so its most relevant risk is quality regression caused by precision changes, graph transformations, or engine tactics.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure reduced-precision engines meet approved accuracy-retention thresholds

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark FP16, BF16, FP8, or INT8 engines against the higher-precision reference and block deployment when accuracy retention falls below the accepted threshold.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy retention, perplexity delta, exact-match delta

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Accuracy retention = candidate metric / baseline metric; for generative models compare perplexity, exact match, or other approved task metrics between precisions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure reduced-precision accuracy retention remains above threshold for every supported precision profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT explicitly supports mixed precision, so precision-specific regression testing is a core control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure INT8 calibration uses representative data and is documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use calibration data that reflects production distributions and log the calibration dataset version, scope, and coverage before INT8 engine approval.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = represented production segments / required production segments; post-calibration accuracy delta = baseline metric - calibrated engine metric on the validation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure calibration data covers all required production segments and post-calibration accuracy loss remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT documentation states calibration uses representative input data to minimize INT8 accuracy loss, making calibration governance highly relevant.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure all supported dynamic-shape profiles are validated before release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Test each optimization profile and supported input-shape range so engines do not degrade or fail outside the most common shape path.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Shape-profile pass rate, shape-specific latency, shape-specific accuracy

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = valid profiles tested successfully / total required profiles; compute latency and quality metrics for min, opt, and max shapes per profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure every approved optimization profile passes validation and no supported shape violates quality or performance thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT supports dynamic shapes, but misconfigured optimization profiles can create hidden deployment failures or regressions.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure custom plugins and unsupported-layer paths match reference outputs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where plugins or framework fallbacks are used, validate numerical parity with the reference implementation before release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Reference-output parity error, max absolute error, mean relative error

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare plugin or fallback outputs to reference outputs over the approved validation corpus and compute parity-error statistics.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Exact Match, cosine similarity, N/A numeric parity metric

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure plugin and fallback parity errors remain below the approved numerical threshold.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: Max relative error <1e-3 or project-approved tolerance

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT deployments often rely on plugins or conversion workarounds; these create a real correctness risk even when the base model is sound.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 latency is benchmarked with trtexec or equivalent inference-only profiling

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure inference-only latency after engine build and compare against the approved baseline for the same hardware and workload.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run standardized inference benchmarks with fixed hardware, batch size, and input shapes; compute p95 and mean latency over the benchmark window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency does not exceed the approved baseline by more than the threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT best-practice guidance emphasizes inference-only profiling and benchmark discipline, making latency a primary governance metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure throughput gains are measured for the target batch and shape ranges

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark throughput across approved batch sizes and shapes so optimization benefits are validated for real deployment conditions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Queries per second, tokens per second, images per second

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run workload-specific benchmarks over the approved batch sizes and shapes; compute steady-state throughput and compare it to the production baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved deployment target for each supported serving profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT is adopted primarily for inference acceleration, so throughput validation is a first-order rule.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure engine memory footprint fits the approved deployment envelope

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure peak device memory and workspace usage for each engine profile so memory regressions do not break production capacity planning.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Peak GPU memory, workspace size, weight-streaming footprint

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Collect memory metrics during standardized inference runs for each engine profile and compare against the approved hardware envelope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure peak memory usage remains within the approved hardware envelope for each supported profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT engine plans, workspace, and precision choices can materially change memory requirements.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representative inference runs meet utilization efficiency targets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Profile representative inference workloads so low GPU utilization, launch overhead, or input-pipeline bottlenecks are identified before release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: GPU utilization, SM occupancy, inference efficiency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Collect utilization data during representative inference profiling and compute average utilization and bottleneck indicators over the measurement window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure representative inference runs meet the approved minimum utilization target.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT performance guides stress disciplined profiling because poor utilization can hide invalid optimization assumptions.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure engine-build configuration and tactic choices are versioned for reproducibility

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record TensorRT version, CUDA version, hardware target, builder flags, precision settings, and tactic-related settings for every approved engine build.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = recorded required build fields / total required build fields for each released engine.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure engine-build reproducibility metadata is complete before engine promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT includes algorithm selection and reproducible-build considerations, so build provenance is a real governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure engine inspector output is reviewed for released engines

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Engine Inspector or equivalent tooling to review layer precision, tactics, shapes, and formats before promoting an engine to production.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completion rate = released engines with approved inspection evidence / total released engines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure engine-inspection evidence exists for every released engine.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT's Engine Inspector is highly relevant because precision and tactic selection directly affect behavior and performance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure TensorRT, CUDA, driver, and hardware compatibility is validated before deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Check release compatibility across TensorRT version, CUDA, NVIDIA driver, and target GPU architecture before promoting engine artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = deployment targets passing the compatibility test matrix / total required deployment targets.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all required deployment targets pass the compatibility matrix before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT engine artifacts are tightly coupled to hardware/software stack details, making compatibility a critical release gate.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Hallucination or unsupported-claim regression after quantization

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure generative-model faithfulness is re-evaluated after TensorRT optimization

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For optimized LLM or generative deployments, re-run faithfulness and hallucination benchmarks after engine conversion or quantization to detect semantic regressions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the approved benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold after optimization.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT does not originate these behaviors, but precision and kernel changes can alter generation quality enough to require retesting.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure safety and toxicity benchmarks are rerun after engine conversion

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For models with toxicity or refusal requirements, re-evaluate post-optimization outputs so changes in precision do not silently worsen harmful behavior.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run safety benchmark prompts against the source model and TensorRT engine; compare average toxicity and refusal compliance before release.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: RealToxicityPrompts, toxicity score, safety refusal rate

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity remains below threshold and refusal compliance remains above threshold after optimization.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is only applicable when the optimized model serves safety-sensitive user-facing tasks.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure subgroup fairness metrics are rechecked after precision reduction

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Re-run fairness benchmarks after engine conversion or quantization so subgroup disparities are not worsened by optimization changes.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score, subgroup error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare subgroup benchmark results between the reference model and the TensorRT engine over the approved fairness evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress after optimization.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT optimization can change numerical behavior; fairness-sensitive deployments should verify no subgroup-specific regressions appear.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure layer-wise numerical checks are performed for unstable models

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate layer outputs and investigate layers that are sensitive to lower precision so numerically unstable engines are not released unchecked.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Layer-wise error, max absolute difference, NaN/Inf occurrence rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare selected TensorRT layer outputs against reference outputs and count numerical anomalies such as NaN or Inf across the validation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure layer-wise numerical error and anomaly rates remain below the approved tolerance.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official TensorRT accuracy guidance explicitly recommends validating layer outputs when investigating poor accuracy.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure tactic selection is benchmarked under representative deployment conditions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark candidate engines under deployment-like constraints so tactic choices that only look optimal in build-time search do not degrade real production workloads.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run standardized inference on representative data, hardware, and concurrency settings; compare performance across engines and tactic-related settings.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure selected engine tactics meet approved production-like latency and throughput targets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Build-time tactic search is not enough by itself; operational validation is needed for trustworthy performance claims.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure profiling excludes engine-build time and measures inference only

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Separate engine build and inference phases in performance tests so reported latency and throughput metrics reflect actual serving behavior.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = benchmark runs using documented inference-only measurement procedure / total reviewed benchmark runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all official TensorRT performance reports are based on inference-only profiling procedures.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT performance guidance explicitly warns against mixing build-phase activity into inference profiling.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure serialized engines are validated before deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that serialized engine artifacts load successfully and produce approved benchmark outputs on the target environment before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Engine-load success rate, smoke-test pass rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Engine-load success rate = successful deserializations / total tested engine artifacts; smoke-test pass rate = passed smoke tests / total deployment candidates.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all released engine artifacts deserialize successfully and pass smoke tests on the target environment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT deployments depend on serialized engine artifacts, so artifact validation is a necessary reliability control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every released engine is linked to its source model and conversion pipeline

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Maintain lineage from source framework model or ONNX export to TensorRT engine, including conversion scripts, builder flags, and calibration artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = engines with linked source model, conversion script, build config, and test evidence / total released engines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure complete model-to-engine lineage exists before engine promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because TensorRT produces optimized engine artifacts, traceability to the source model is essential for auditability and rollback.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure precision, tactics, and tensor formats are reviewable for released engines

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Capture engine-inspection details so reviewers can understand the deployed precision path, tactic choices, and tensor-format assumptions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = engines with retained inspection output covering required review fields / total released engines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure explainability evidence exists for all released TensorRT engines.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT's Engine Inspector provides a practical transparency surface for otherwise opaque optimized engines.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Unvalidated weight streaming or tiling behavior

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure advanced engine options are benchmarked before production use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where weight streaming, tiling optimization, or similar advanced features are enabled, benchmark them separately before approving production deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Feature-specific latency delta, throughput delta, memory delta

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compare the advanced-feature engine against the approved baseline engine under the same hardware and workload conditions.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure advanced engine options do not violate approved performance or memory thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT documents advanced options like weight streaming and tiling, but they should be treated as release-specific changes that need direct evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure batch-size-specific quality and latency are validated

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Test approved batch sizes individually so changes in batching do not hide unexpected quality or latency regressions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run validation and performance tests separately for each approved batch size and record quality and latency metrics per batch.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure each approved batch size independently meets the required quality and latency thresholds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT performance can vary materially by batch size, especially with dynamic shapes and tactic selection.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure long-tail or outlier inputs are included in post-quantization validation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Augment validation with rare, extreme, or numerically sensitive examples so quantization failures are not hidden by average-case metrics.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Outlier failure rate, worst-case accuracy delta

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Evaluate an approved long-tail test set and compute the failure rate and worst-case metric delta between the reference model and the TensorRT engine.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure outlier failure rate and worst-case accuracy delta remain within approved limits after quantization.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Average validation may miss precision-sensitive edge cases, so long-tail testing is particularly important for optimized engines.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Spreading disinformation due to optimized-output regression

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality is rechecked for optimized generative deployments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative models deployed through TensorRT, re-run factuality benchmarks after conversion so any semantic drift from optimization is detected.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from the approved evaluator over the benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold after TensorRT optimization.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Only applicable for TensorRT deployments serving generative or retrieval-grounded content tasks.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved and verified engine artifacts are deployed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict deployment to validated engine artifacts produced by the approved build pipeline and verified against release metadata.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Deployment rate = deployments using verified approved engine artifacts / total TensorRT deployments in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all production deployments use only approved and verified TensorRT engine artifacts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT relies on serialized engine artifacts, so artifact provenance and approval are essential supply-chain controls.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure release testing covers quality, precision, long-tail, and performance domains

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a TensorRT validation standard that includes task quality, reduced-precision accuracy, dynamic shapes, long-tail inputs, and operational performance instead of speed-only benchmarking.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated TensorRT validation domains with active tests / total mandated domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure automated TensorRT risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across required validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT release quality cannot be judged by latency alone; the governance program must require representative quality validation too.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure source-model documentation is linked to every released TensorRT engine

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Associate each released engine with model-card details, intended use, known limitations, licensing, and baseline metrics from the source model.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required source-model transparency fields / total required fields for each released engine.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure source-model transparency completeness is 100% before engine release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT inherits many risks from the source model, so model-card linkage remains important even though TensorRT is only the inference layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment architecture and hardware assumptions are documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the deployment stack, target GPU architecture, precision modes, shape profiles, and serving assumptions associated with each TensorRT engine release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required deployment and dependency fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness is 100% before production release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: TensorRT artifacts are deployment-specific, so hardware and runtime assumptions are part of the true system boundary.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for TensorRT
